details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:156-201 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` can leave an issue with multiple mutually-exclusive phase labels because non-404 DELETE failures are only warned about and the new label is still posted.
  WHY: All reviewers identified the same root cause in the DELETE-then-POST transition logic; the highest severity/confidence were critical/5, and the issue breaks the phase-label invariant downstream.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2398-2442 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The workflow’s sourcing path can silently fall back to a weaker inline `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` implementation when `label_helpers.sh` fails to load.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed that `2>/dev/null` masks sourcing failures and the fallback only posts the new label, so the same stale-label root cause can reappear without visibility; severity is raised to the highest reported among merged findings.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2629-3122 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The workflow still contains the large inline `diagnose_post_codex_failure` block instead of invoking `scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh`, leaving the extraction incomplete.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers reported the same refactor mismatch and noted the script is orphaned while the inline block remains; one reviewer called out the bootstrap copy too, but the shared root cause here is the main workflow not calling the extracted script.
- .codex-workflow-src/.github/workflows/implement.yml:2620-2640 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The bootstrap snapshot’s `implement.yml` still has the old inline `diagnose_post_codex_failure` logic and is out of sync with the refactor.
  WHY: This is the same incomplete extraction/parity problem as the main workflow, but it applies to the bootstrap copy specifically and was called out separately.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:196-205 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The PR-metadata fallback only normalizes literal `"null"` values and was reported as potentially missing other empty-or-missing payload cases.
  WHY: Reviewers raised the same null-handling concern, but one explicitly marked the implementation as already correct for GitHub Actions context; keep the highest reported severity/confidence while preserving that disagreement.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:1-568 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The extracted diagnosis script was reported as having fragile/inefficient patterns such as repeated `jq` use and weaker error-handling cleanup.
  WHY: These were presented as minor robustness concerns rather than functional bugs, so they remain a separate low-severity consensus item.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:165-193 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The per-label DELETE loop can make up to ten API calls per phase transition, increasing rate-limit pressure.
  WHY: This is distinct from the stale-label bug because it concerns API volume rather than correctness; reviewers agreed on the same efficiency/rate-limit root cause.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:156-201 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function fails to ensure mutually exclusive phase labels when DELETE operations fail.
  WHY: An issue could end up with multiple phase labels (e.g., `ai:done` AND `ai:ready-to-merge`), breaking downstream logic that assumes at most one phase label.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2417-2442 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Stderr redirection can mask sourcing failures, causing the workflow to use a simplified fallback implementation that doesn't properly transition labels.
  WHY: The simplified fallback only POSTs the new label without deleting old ones, potentially leaving multiple phase labels.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:196-198 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The code only checks for literal `"null"` strings but may miss other empty or missing payload cases like empty strings or missing GitHub Actions context values.
  WHY: Could fail to extract issue numbers from PR body/title when payload is empty but not `"null"`.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:156-201 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The function makes up to 10 DELETE calls per issue, risking rate limits.
  WHY: In high-volume workflows, could hit GitHub API rate limits.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Repeated `jq` subprocesses and silent fallback behavior when assets are missing.
  WHY: Could fail silently or be inefficient, but likely won't cause runtime failures.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2629-3122 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Still contains inline implementation instead of calling extracted script.
  WHY: Code duplication, maintenance burden, but functionally equivalent.
- .codex-workflow-src/.github/workflows/implement.yml | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Bootstrap snapshot not updated.
  WHY: Could cause workflow runs to use outdated logic.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~2629-3122 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The workflow still contains the full ~500-line inline block for `diagnose_post_codex_failure`, even though `scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh` has been created.
  WHY: The workflow has not been updated to stage the new script nor replace the inline `run:` block with a call to the extracted script, so fixes can drift and the implementation phase can fail during diagnosis.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:182-200 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` treats all non-404 DELETE failures as warnings and still proceeds to add the new label.
  WHY: This breaks the mutually-exclusive phase-label invariant and can leave multiple labels on an issue.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:196-201 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback checks for `PR_TITLE == "null"` and `PR_BODY == "null"` but does not check for empty strings or payloads that might return `"null"` within the `gh api` fallback call itself.
  WHY: Empty env vars can still trigger redundant API calls or noise strings, reducing robustness.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2398-2402 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The workflow tries to source `label_helpers.sh` from `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` and then `scripts/`, while redirecting `stderr` to `/dev/null`.
  WHY: A syntax error or missing dependency can fail silently and force the job onto weaker inline definitions without visible diagnostics.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:1-568 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The extracted diagnosis script has repeated `jq` calls, fragile error handling, and no guaranteed temp-file cleanup.
  WHY: These are robustness and efficiency issues that can cause degraded behavior, though they were not presented as definite functional failures.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/label_helpers. sh:147-202 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` function can leave issues with multiple phase labels because non-404 DELETE failures are warned about and ignored, and the function always returns success.
  WHY: When a DELETE fails with a permission, network, or rate-limit error, the function still adds the new target label, resulting in multiple `ai:*` phase labels simultaneously.
- scripts/label_ helpers.sh:165-193 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Deleting phase labels one-by-one uses up to 10 API calls per issue.
  WHY: Under heavy workflow traffic, this can consume significant API budget and increase rate-limit risk.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix. yml:24395-24422 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback loading chain hides sourcing errors and can silently fall back to weaker inline definitions that do not properly remove old phase labels.
  WHY: If the full helper script has issues but still partially sources, debugging is hard and the fallback implementation lacks the resilient label-transition behavior.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status. yml:196-205 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The null-handling logic only checks for literal `"null"` strings and may miss empty or missing payload cases.
  WHY: The subsequent whitespace check should catch empties, but the error-message path could be clearer.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~2629-3122 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The script `scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh` was extracted from the workflow, but the inline `diagnose_post_codex_failure` step still exists and the script is never called.
  WHY: The extracted script is orphaned while the workflow keeps the full inline logic, causing duplication and drift.
- .codex-workflow-src/.github/workflows/implement.yml | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The bootstrap snapshot directory contains `implement.yml` with the old inline `diagnose_post_codex_failure` block.
  WHY: Consumer repos bootstrapping from this snapshot get outdated code and miss the refactor parity.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:156-201 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` warns on DELETE failures but continues to add the new label regardless.
  WHY: Non-404 DELETE failures leave potentially multiple mutually-exclusive phase labels on the issue, breaking orchestrator phase logic.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2417-2442 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `2>/dev/null` can hide partial sourcing failures and cause the workflow to silently fall back to the weaker inline implementation.
  WHY: Operators lose visibility into why the resilient helper was not loaded.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:196-198 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The fallback only normalizes explicit `"null"` strings.
  WHY: The reviewer ultimately marked this implementation as already correct for GitHub Actions context, so this is not treated as a bug here.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The script has repeated `jq` calls, weaker error handling, and possible temp-file cleanup gaps.
  WHY: These are minor quality issues rather than functional bugs.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
